name: Secret Book
summary: Myrie asks you for a copy of a children's book. But for some reason, you can't find the version she is looking for anywhere.

steps.journal: Myrie wants a copy of The Great Benefactor, a children's book. She was particular about the version.

objectives.text: Ask the bookseller for the book

steps.journal: Penwick sold me the only edition he has. He said the older printings were all collected by the Cathedral years ago.
Myrie says this isn't it. She remembers a different ending. Penwick mentioned an old reading room that may still have one.

objectives.text: Find a first printing of The Great Benefactor

steps.journal: The first printing. Some pages read differently from Penwick's copy.

objectives.text: Bring the first printing to Myrie
